name: Engineer
summary: Owns one ticket end to end in its own worktree: root cause and plan, build, validate against the contract, review, launch card, PR.

planReviewFrom.label: Mate reviews the plan before building from this difficulty up (simple, moderate, complex, critical)

scopeLimitFiles.label: Plans touching more files than this get cut down before building

maxFixRounds.label: Fix rounds on one review before the engineer stops and asks the Mate (the reviewer's own limit also applies)
